test_AudioDecoder_init_unsupported_dtype: test that AudioDecoder raises ValueError when initialized with an unsupported dtype like torch.bool
test_AudioDecoder_decode_ogg_audio: test that AudioDecoder correctly decodes an OGG Vorbis audio file from a MemoryBlock into a waveform tensor
test_AudioDecoder_reject_non_memory_bloc: test that AudioDecoder raises ValueError when called with non-MemoryBlock inputs like None, int, or string
test_AudioDecoder_reject_empty_memory_bl: test that AudioDecoder raises ValueError when called with an empty MemoryBlock containing zero bytes
test_AudioDecoder_reject_invalid_audio_d: test that AudioDecoder raises ValueError when called with a MemoryBlock containing invalid audio data
